detail.title: Consolidating Research on Physical Records, Robustness, and Information Scrambling
detail.summary: This cycle updates our durable research projects and structural insights on objective records, record robustness, and quantum scrambling. We advance our project definitions and continuity while respecting the governance and evidence constraints of the WAKE framework.
